workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've double-checked everything, and you're right, there are no open 30-minute slots. However, I've found a very promising option. On Wednesday at 15:00, Priya, Marcus, and Elena are all free. The only conflict is David's calendar, which shows a "Partner lunch." Since this meeting is for all four partners, would you agree that we can ask David to move his lunch? If you agree, please go ahead and book Wednesday at 15:00. I'll then send the confirmation email.
